messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick proposal — we keep hitting mismatch spikes when SI partners send hourly device snapshots (lost connectivity) and our ingestion prefers per-event. Thoughts on deterministic allocation rules?

alex-engr: TL;DR: prefer per-event, fallback to snapshot; but we need clear tie-breakers + flags for downstream billing to avoid double-counting.

sophia-finance: +1. Also need a charge-adjustment window rule (e.g., 48h) so invoices aren't permanently churned if late data arrives.

kevin-partner-sr: From partner side — many edge devices buffer hourly summaries for battery reasons. We can send event-level when online but it's not reliable. We need reconciliation to accept hourly as canonical sometimes.

maria-partnerships: Proposed rules (draft):
```
1) If event-level records exist for device_id during hour H => use event-level aggregation for H.
2) Else if exactly one hourly snapshot for device_id@H => use snapshot but mark source=partner_snapshot.
3) If both event + snapshot exist but totals differ by <5% => prefer event-level, record discrepancy metric.
4) If difference >=5% => keep event-level and create an auto-dispute ticket for partner sync.
5) Late arrivals: data arriving >billing_cutoff and <=48h => create 'adjustment' entry with invoice memo; >48h => queue to next billing period as credit proposal.
```

kevin-ops: Implementation notes: we should ingest snapshots into a separate reconciliations table with the fields: (device_id, hour, reported_total, source, received_at). Draft SQL: 
```sql
INSERT INTO partner_snapshots (device_id, hour, reported_total, source, received_at) VALUES (...)
-- reconciliation job runs hourly:
WITH ev AS (SELECT device_id, hour, SUM(units) AS ev_total FROM events WHERE hour=H GROUP BY device_id)
SELECT coalesce(ev.device_id, ps.device_id) AS device_id, coalesce(ev.ev_total, ps.reported_total) AS chosen_total, 
CASE WHEN ev.ev_total IS NOT NULL THEN 'event' ELSE 'snapshot' END AS chosen_source
FROM ev FULL OUTER JOIN partner_snapshots ps ON ev.device_id = ps.device_id AND ev.hour = ps.hour;
```

ana-sre: We need idempotency keys from partners (snapshot_id) and deterministic dedupe. Also watch out for timezone normalization — partner sends local hour sometimes.

kevin-partner-sr: Can add snapshot_id and tz in payload. We'll push a contract change. We'll also include a 'confidence' float (0-1) to hint when device had measured gaps.

alex-engr: Confidence is useful but must not be authoritative. We should map confidence <0.6 => treat snapshot as advisory only and prefer aggregated historical baselines + smoothing. Also emit metric 'snapshot_conflict' to product dashboards.

sophia-finance: For billing language: adjustments should be visible on invoice lines (e.g., "Adjustment: device X hour H, +12 units (late arrival)"). Legal wants a maximum net adjustment cap per invoice to avoid surprise. Propose cap 2% of invoice value or $500, whichever smaller.

maria-partnerships: Action items I/O: 
- Partners: add snapshot_id, tz, confidence to hourly payload (kevin-partner-sr) 
- Eng: implement reconciliation table + job, emit metrics + create auto-dispute tickets (alex-engr) 
- Ops/SRE: add idempotency and backfill runner for late arrivals (ana-sre) 
- Finance: define invoice adjustment presentation + cap (sophia-finance)

billing-bot: SUMMARY: reconciliation rule set accepted in thread. Created ticket PRJ-4592 for reconciliation job. Next sync with partner scheduled Tue 09:30 PT. :white_check_mark:

kevin-partner-sr: Thanks — will send API schema update before EOD Friday.

maria-partnerships: Great. We'll draft a short runbook for disputes and share on Monday. Thanks everyone! :)
